task_title: Fix orphaned scratch daemons in integration tests
task_criteria: tests/helpers.ts: (a) curl probes must have --max-time; (b) scratch daemons need process-level reaper; (c) pin isolated namespace root + port for all test daemons. AC: (1) stuck curl fails test instead of hanging (assert timeout in <15s on a stalled probe), (2) after test hard-kill, orphaned duckbrain http processes are detected and killed (assert no duckbrain http processes survive >60s after test exit), (3) scratch daemons never inherit host config — assert DUCKBRAIN_NAMESPACES_PATH and port are set. Evidence: repro script that spawns daemon, hangs curl, verifies suite timeout; post-kill process scan.
